title: ITR filed under old regime, tax calculated under new regime; Delhi ITAT gives taxpayer relief
summary: A Delhi ITAT ruling has given relief to a taxpayer whose accountant mistakenly selected the old tax regime in ITR-1 even though tax had been computed under the new regime. The tribunal directed the AO to compute the taxpayer’s liability under the new regime.

title: End of free era for UPI: Here's what changes, what doesn't
